-- name: productAnalytics
SELECT id, details, prices, dimensions, fulfillment,
       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY active ORDER BY price_cents DESC) AS rank
FROM products QUALIFY rank <= $1;

SELECT o.id, struct_pack(id := o.id, status := o.status, totalCents := o.total_cents, customer := struct_pack(email := u.email)) AS document
  FROM orders AS o JOIN users AS u ON u.id = o.user_id
  WHERE o.id = $1

-- name: revenueByCustomer
WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue_cents
  FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT u.id, LOWER(u.email) AS email, p.order_count, p.revenue_cents
FROM users AS u JOIN paid_orders AS p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE p.revenue_cents >= $1
ORDER BY p.revenue_cents DESC;

SELECT o.id, JSON_OBJECT(
    'id', o.id,
    'status', o.status,
    'totalCents', o.total_cents,
    'customer', JSON_OBJECT('email', u.email),
    'items', COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
      'sku', p.sku, 'quantity', i.quantity,
      'unitPriceCents', i.unit_price_cents
    )), JSON_ARRAY())
  ) AS document
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN users AS u ON u.id = o.user_id
  JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
  WHERE o.id = ?
  GROUP BY o.id, o.status, o.total_cents, u.email

  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
         SUM(total_cents) AS revenue_cents
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT u.id, display_email(u.email) AS email,
       p.order_count, p.revenue_cents
FROM users AS u
JOIN paid_orders AS p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE p.revenue_cents >= ?
ORDER BY p.revenue_cents DESC;
